## What and why

## Definition of done
- [ ] Works on a real Android device (if mobile)
- [ ] Tests added and passing, including a cross-user test for any user-data endpoint
- [ ] Loading, empty, error and offline states handled
- [ ] Theme tokens used, 44px touch targets, accessibility labels, usable at 200% font scale
- [ ] No private text (journals, notes, prompts) in logs, analytics, Sentry or notifications
- [ ] New tables call secure_table(); migrations apply to an empty database
- [ ] OpenAPI spec and TypeScript types regenerated
- [ ] Any AI path has a per-user quota, a token ceiling and schema-validated output
- [ ] No new secret in code; .env.example updated
- [ ] Docs or ADR updated
